# mistershell_local_auth_policy (Resource)

Binds configuration of an existing backend-owned object. Create captures originals and applies only configured fields; destroy restores those originals and never deletes the object. Removing a field restores and releases it. Import explicitly adopts current readable configuration. One binding per object/configuration surface. ID must be local. configuration = { mfa_method = none or totp }. Email MFA and adoption of an email baseline require interactive proof and cannot be managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_local_auth_policy" "local" {
  id            = "local"
  configuration = { mfa_method = "totp" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) ID must be local. configuration = { mfa_method = none or totp }. Email MFA and adoption of an email baseline require interactive proof and cannot be managed.
- `id` (String) Existing object ID, stable catalog key, or local. This binding never creates the backend object.

### Read-Only

- `original_configuration` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Original owned configuration retained in state for restoration. Do not edit; protect Terraform state.
